lines.text: This is casper-webrtc-stream — HTTP-native money, settled on Casper.
Apps and agents need to pay per call. Card rails can't. Crypto checkout is clunky.
x402 fixes it. The server asks for payment, the client pays, the request retries.
Gate any route in one line — paymentMiddleware.
Pay automatically with one wrapped fetch. The 402 just disappears.
Every payment is real — a CEP-18 transfer, settled on-chain, confirmed in seconds.
casper-webrtc-stream. The payment rail for the agent economy. On Casper.
